text.text_excerpt: I don't understand the poor reviews for this hotel. I've stayed here multiple times and it is actually one of the really nicer hotels in and around the quarter! We get a room sometimes when we want to party in the quarter and not drive home drunk. Simple as that. We use priceline, too, and once in a while, we end up with Hyatt. I have NEVER had to wait in a line longer than 2 or 3 people deep here. But then again, I have never really stayed here for a convention or anything like that. Like I said, I stay here because I want to party and crash. That's about it. There is an absolutely STUNNING view on their gym floor of the Superdome, The Urinal and of the rest of the city, so don't forget ...

Great hotel! The valet entry is quite small and can easily cause traffic to back up both once we were able to turn in everything was good. I was able to check in online and use the kiosk machine in the lobby to get my keys. Getting to the rooms is another story! We had to go up 2 escalators, walk through some restaurants, then use special elevators to get to our room. Each time we went back to the room the elevator alphabet changed. There is a machine that you scan your key under and it tells you which elevator to take for that particular trip. It's neat but also a little tedious. The hotel is huge and offers 24 hour room service which is nice. We were going to an event at the smoothie ki...

The room was a little small, but man, those beds are comfortable! The escalator up to the guest rooms is a little annoying, but not really that bad. They have apparently recently renovated this hotel and it's pretty stylish for a major chain! There was some iridescent reptile-patterned wallpaper in the bathrooms and mirrored vanities. Very modern and nice. Everyone we spoke to in reception and all the service people were very friendly. The location is right next to the Superdome, which wasn't as bad as I thought it would be, even during the Sugar Bowl.
